test_objective: Check that you can update a temporal representation of an entity with simple temporal properties

test_cases.name: 008_01_01 Update a temporal representation of an entity with simple temporal properties
test_cases.doc: Check that you can update a temporal representation of an entity with simple temporal properties
test_cases.then:
then {
    the SUT sends a valid Response for the operations:
        Create Or Update Temporal Representation Of Entity Selecting Content Type with Response Status Code set to 201     and
        Create Or Update Temporal Representation Of Entity Selecting Content Type with Response Status Code set to 204     and
        Retrieve Temporal Representation Of Entity with Check Updated Entity and
            Query Parameter: 'updated_resource' set to 'temporal_entity_expectation_payload' and
            Query Parameter: 'response_body' set to 'response2.json()' and
            Query Parameter: 'ignored_keys' set to 'ignored_attributes'
}
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/temporal/entities'
        method set to 'POST'
        Create or Update Temporal Representation of Entity Selecting Content Type: and
    Query Parameter: temporal_entity_representation_id set to '${temporal_entity_representation_id}' and
    Query Parameter: filename set to 'vehicle-create-temporal-representation-sample.jsonld' and
    Query Parameter: content_type set to 'application/ld+json' and
    Query Parameter: accept set to '${EMPTY}'
}
